summary: SCYNEXIS Inc. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval and board adoption of a 1-for-8 reverse stock split, effective May 29, 2026. The amendment reduces authorized shares from 150M to 18.75M with no par value change. No price, premium, or third-party advisor is mentioned; the split is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. The filing includes no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. This is an ordinary corporate action to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, not a special situation.
